images.author: Christopher L. Riley
images.caption: Front view of four commercial buildings in Celina, Ohio. The buildings are contributing parts of the National Register-listed Main Street Commercial Historic District.

facade.notes: one of four contiguous fronts on Main Street, Celina OH (historic district); left to right: white Italianate, lavender Italianate, green Queen Anne, Romanesque bank; all share zero setback, a storefront band at the same height, 2-3 storeys and party walls -- different styles held together by height, rhythm and setback; this one: four round-arched windows a floor under ornate hood moulds, painted lavender, a bracketed cornice; a stair door at one side of the storefront leads to the upper floors

why.note: the street wall: every front on the line, so the styles can differ
the upper floors' own street door beside the shop: the two-part block's private zone
